lesson_title: Longitudinal System Identification from Skywalker X8 UAV Flight Tests
artifact_access_detail: DataverseNO Version 1.0 provides public, unauthenticated, CC0-1.0 machine-readable Skywalker X8 flight records. The selected teaching subset is seven longitudinal training CSVs and two longitudinal validation CSVs, now pinned and processed by deterministic course artifacts under research/data/skywalker-x8-v1/. Two MIT OCW perching-glider rasters remain contextual motivation from a different vehicle; they are not digitized, pooled, or compared numerically.

primary_dataset.title: System identification campaign - Skywalker X8 UAV
primary_dataset.required_citation: Løw-Hansen, Bogdan; Hann, Richard, 2024, System identification campaign - Skywalker X8 UAV, DataverseNO, V1, https://doi.org/10.18710/U4TLYV

checks.detail: The public DataverseNO APIs report DOI 10.18710/U4TLYV, Version 1.0, and CC0 1.0 Universal. DOI, version, file IDs, and per-file MD5 form the immutable course contract.

The measured vehicle is a Skywalker X8 small fixed-wing UAV. Data were collected 2023-05-08 at Agdenes Airfield, Norway, in strong northwesterly wind with a significant vertical component. No perching maneuver is claimed.

The repository contains 17 maneuvers: 13 creator-designated training and four validation. The longitudinal teaching subset contains seven training and two validation maneuvers spanning 3211 elevator sequences and elevator doublets.
Every maneuver is a separate ordered record whose first row is n=0, t=0. Never concatenate a last row to the next file's first row, and reset every lag or free-run state at each boundary.

The README declares headerless 41-column CSVs. The nine longitudinal files contain 3,828 structurally complete rows with no missing values in the scout audit. Abort on nonnumeric rows or a column count other than 41; do not silently impute or bridge.

Released records are nominally 40 Hz (T_s=0.025 s). STIM300 IMU channels were downsampled from 200 Hz, GPS and propulsion channels upsampled from 10 Hz, and command channels originated at 40 Hz; channels were manually synchronized. Verify time differences per file and qualify delay claims.

Primary proposal: elevator command column 2 (rad) to IMU_angvel_q column 9 (rad/s). Declared supporting fields may include EstimatedState_theta column 12 (rad), EstimatedState_q column 15 (rad/s), EstimatedState_w column 19 (m/s), EstimatedState_alpha column 26 (rad), TrueSpeed column 28 (m/s), and IndicatedSpeed column 29 (m/s). EstimatedState_alpha is not a stall label.

Choose preprocessing, lag, effective delay, order, scaling, and coefficients using only the seven creator-designated longitudinal training files. Freeze the pipeline before opening longitudinal_3211_5.csv and longitudinal_doublet_4.csv, then report both validation maneuvers separately and in aggregate.

The frozen course comparison uses matched-order input-free AR(2), q_hat_0[n]=c0+a01 q[n-1]+a02 q[n-2], against pitch-rate ARX(2,1,1), q_hat[n]=c+a1 q[n-1]+a2 q[n-2]+b1 u[n-1]. This is a course recomputation, not a model supplied by the dataset authors. One-step and free-run behavior are reported separately, and no MIT flat-plate baseline is imported.

The frozen ARX(2,1,1) has strictly lower RMSE and NRMSE than matched-order input-free AR(2) in one-step and free-run modes on both validation maneuvers. Equal-maneuver macro NRMSE improves 12.0% one-step and 60.3% free-run; both ARX roots have magnitude 0.9102. One-step residual ACF crosses the descriptive reference band in both files, so the supported conclusion is predictively better but structurally incomplete.

MIT 6.003 perching lift/drag and trajectory rasters may motivate why model validation matters. They depict a different vehicle and may not supply numeric samples, regimes, thresholds, or comparisons for the Skywalker X8 study.

Orfanidis §28.4.3 is retained narrowly for an autoregressive prediction/generalization example and residual correlation. Stoica-Moses Chapter 1 §§1.1 and 1.5 are retained for finite-record/model limitations, not as a flight-identification derivation.

computed_artifacts.privacy: Derived artifacts exclude GPS and location fields.

issues.detail: Manual synchronization and multirate resampling make an identified sample lag an effective released-record lag, not an exact actuator-delay measurement.
Strong wind and different excitation maneuvers can create structured residual changes; report them as observed associations, not isolated aerodynamic mechanisms.
Do not convert angle of attack or validation-folder membership into a stall label or threshold.
MIT perching rasters and Skywalker X8 CSVs describe different vehicles and campaigns. Keep contextual imagery visibly separated from computed X8 evidence.
